note: Stage 1 rules for MirsadEngine. All regex patterns run on the normalised text (lowercase, tashkeel stripped, alef/ya/ta-marbuta unified, Arabic-Indic digits mapped to ASCII). Weights are in [-1, 1]; 'hard' reasons gate HOLD. Reasons with the same code are merged (max weight, hard if any is hard).

scoring.comment: rulesScore = 1 - exp(-k * max(0, sum of weights)); final = 1 - (1 - rulesScore) * (1 - modelWeight * P(scam)). The classifier alone cannot exceed modelWeight and never satisfies the hard gate.

links.comment: Brand tokens shorter than brandSubstringMinLength must match a whole host label; longer ones may be substrings. Official domains whose second-level label has 4 or fewer letters use the short max distance.

calls.comment: Wangiri (one-ring) and premium-rate country/area prefixes. Both call reasons are WARN-level only.

arabizi.comment: Latin-script Arabic. strong tokens count 2, weak tokens 1, digit-as-letter tokens 2; LATIN_ARABIC when the total is at least 3 and no Arabic script is present.

reasonDetails.comment: Details never contain raw message text: hosts, entity ids, prefixes and rule labels only.
